title: Department of Energy award will support KU research to develop new computational framework for improving simulations
summary_en: Cheng Huang, assistant professor of aerospace engineering at the University of Kansas, has won a five-year, $875,000 grant from the U.S. Department of Energy through the DOE’s Office of Science Early Career Research Program.
title_cn: Department of Energy award will support KU research to develop new computational framework for improving simulations

title: Ashley Shew to discuss techno-ableism at biannual Hall Center in Wichita event
summary_en: The Hall Center for the Humanities will host its biannual Hall Center in Wichita event Nov. 9 at the Wichita Art Museum. Virginia Tech researcher Ashley Shew will present “Walkie Talkies & Other Technoableist Dreams.”
title_cn: Ashley Shew to discuss techno-ableism at biannual Hall Center in Wichita event
